description.value: Timberland Pub is a neighbourhood pub and liquor store in the Cassidy/Ladysmith area of Vancouver Island, offering dine-in and takeout with a full menu of pub classics including fresh local oysters and daily specials. The pub features pool tables, dart boards, keno, and an outdoor patio. A separately operated liquor store sits next door, making it a handy one-stop for a meal and supplies.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at timberlandpub.ca is live and confirms this is an active pub and liquor store at 1680 Timberlands Rd, though the website gives the city as Ladysmith, BC (V9G 1K3) while OSM says Cassidy — Cassidy is an unincorporated community within the Ladysmith area, so both are plausible, but the website's value is used. The website consistently spells the business name 'Timberland Pub' (no trailing 's') while OSM has 'Timberlands Pub', which is flagged as a concern. Takeout is confirmed by 'Dine In – Take Out' on the homepage; vegetarian-friendly items (pakora, garden salad, yam fries) are evident from ingredient descriptions in the menu subpage; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM has 'Timberlands Pub' (with trailing 's') but the website consistently uses 'Timberland Pub' throughout all pages including the domain name.
City discrepancy: OSM addr:city is 'Cassidy' but the website contact page lists the city as 'Ladysmith, BC V9G 1K3'. Website value used in address field.
Phone not present in OSM tags; value taken from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pub and liquor store with a live website, confirmed address, and full menu. Useful stopping point for touring cyclists in the Cassidy/Ladysmith corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists clearly vegetarian items by ingredients: Pakora (chickpea flour, spinach, cauliflower), Garden Salad, Yam Fries, Nachos. No explicit GF or vegan labelling found
